platforms.catalogAsOf: as stated on page in Sep 2026

platforms.name: Deezer
platforms.catalogAsOf: as stated on page in Sep 2026
platforms.catalogSource: Deezer offers page, 'Compare all plans' table
platforms.users: 9.1 million total subscribers (Dec 31, 2025); 8.9 million total and 5.8 million direct subscribers (H1 2026, to June 30, 2026)
platforms.usersSource: Deezer investor relations key figures page (9.1M); Music Business Worldwide reporting Deezer's H1 2026 results of July 28, 2026 (8.9M / 5.8M)
platforms.notes: H1 2026 subscriber source: https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/deezers-direct-subscribers-grow-to-5-8m-in-h1-2026-but-total-subscriber-base-falls-to-8-9m/ . Daily deliveries (Deezer Newsroom): about 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks delivered per day, more than 50% of all daily uploads at peak in June 2026 (Jul 21, 2026, https://newsroom-deezer.com/2026/07/ai-music-exceeds-50-percent-daily-uploads-deezer/). Earlier: nearly 75,000 AI tracks per day, 44% of daily uploads, and 13.4 million AI tracks detected in 2025 (Apr 20, 2026, https://newsroom-deezer.com/2026/04/ai-generated-tracks-represent-44-of-new-uploaded-music/). Deezer does not state a total tracks-delivered-per-day number; the 50% share implies roughly 180,000 at peak, but that is our arithmetic, not a Deezer figure. AI tracks are 1-3% of streams.
